data.body: CORRECTION (per maintainer): the root-cause attribution in this ticket's description is WRONG. llm-review (and the main-only checks) being SKIPPED on PR1 is INTENTIONAL — llm-review fires only on merges into main, so on a worktree->staged-* PR (base != main) it correctly skips. That is not the cause of the wait-for-pr timeout. PR1 (#489, base=staged-*) is governed by the sub-PR ruleset (review-sub-pr required, which passed), so it was genuinely mergeable; it was merged manually. The actual reason wait-for-pr.sh waited 3600s for a terminal state (rather than the PR merging) is still open and lives in the merge-pipeline (auto-merge firing / manual-merge expectation) — deferring root cause to the CI/PR owners. Do NOT treat the intentional llm-review skip as a defect.
